newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya sells $128 million of treasury bills.
newsitem.headline: Kenya sells $128 million of treasury bills.

text.p: The Central Bank of Kenya sold 6.947 billion shillings ($129 million) of treasury bills at the weekly auction, bank officials said on Thursday.
In the main 91-day category, the bank sold 6.526 billion shillings at an average yield of 19.904 percent compared to 8.971 billion shillings at 20.149 percent last week.
In the 28-day category, it sold 421 million shillings at an unchanged 16.50 percent. Last week, it sold 39 million shillings.
The bank invited tenders for six billion shillings of treasury bills for next week's auction on Thursday.
